items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: He was up there with P. Ron in his outfit there.

ctx.x: He was, oh, yeah. He was up there with P. Ron in his outfit there. The roof garden. He had a roof garden. Right where that civic building is.
Yeah, I know. I know George Geno told me this is wonderful. He raves the band.
